moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio lk-grain, written here): New noise every frame at 24 fps (~42 ms), 7 % opacity (5-10 %). Demo: 900 specks 1.4 px, half white half black, at 25 % opacity, re-seeded every 1/24 s over the art. Params: opacity (7 %) · fps (24) · size: cỡ hạt.
